# Golden wire bytes, written by hand from the tables in docs/architecture/protocol.md. Each line is
# `name: hex`, one whole message with its 8-byte header; spaces split fields and mean nothing.
# The Rust server tests (segment-log-server/src/protocol/tests.rs) encode each answer and encode
# and decode each request; the Go client tests (clients/go/wire_test.go) encode each request and
# decode each answer. Each side fails if it has no check for a line, or a check for a missing line.
# Every status code appears in at least one answer; the Rust test fails when one is missing.

# Requests
hello: 08000000 01 000000 53474c50 0100 0000
append: 2a000000 02 000000 02000000 0100 0000 01000000 00 0000000000000000 73 70 0100 0100 00000000 01 0700000000000000 74 6b
read: 0c000000 03 000000 0300000000000000 09000000
watermark: 00000000 04 000000
stream-head: 06000000 05 000000 6f7264657273
seal: 00000000 06 000000
